explanation: A king of Judah who ruled in the 9th century BC, known for his wickedness and idolatry.
One of the twelve tribes of Israel and a kingdom in the southern part of ancient Israel.
An important prophet in the Old Testament, who performed miracles and spoke God's word to the people.
An ancient kingdom southeast of Israel, often in conflict with Israel and Judah.
A city in ancient Israel that rebelled against Jehoram's rule because of his wickedness.
Jehoram was struck by a severe intestinal disease as punishment from God for his evil deeds.
Jehoram died after two years of suffering from the illness, and his death was not mourned by the people of Judah.
